title: Claim Timetable Card for the Travel Protection Plans
content:
The four periods that govern the life of a claim on the Travel Protection Plans are carried by the plan,
not by the benefit claimed. The filing deadline and the document deadline are counted in calendar days, the
decision target in business days, and the appeal window in calendar days.

| Plan | File within, from the incident (days) | Documents within, from filing (days) | Decision target (business days) | Appeal within, from the decision (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 20 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 20 | 30 | 25 | 30 |
| TripGuard Plus | 30 | 60 | 20 | 45 |
| TripGuard Premier | 45 | 90 | 15 | 60 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 45 | 90 | 15 | 60 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 30 | 60 | 20 | 45 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 60 | 90 | 10 | 90 |

## The same timetable read plan by plan

A traveller on Trip Basics Essential or Trip Basics Standard has 20 days from the incident to file and 30 days
from filing to get the documents in, is told a decision target of 30 business days on the first plan and 25 on
the second, and has 30 days to appeal. On TripGuard Plus and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller the same periods are
30, 60, 20 and 45. On TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite they are 45, 90, 15 and 60. Annual
Multi-Trip Executive carries the longest filing and appeal periods in the range, 60 and 90 days, with 90 days
for documents and the shortest decision target of the seven at 10 business days.
